breaking_changes.BC_description: The package has been converted to an ES module and now requires Node 18 or higher. Projects using Node 16 or below will no longer be compatible.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Either upgrade to Node 18+ or use version 7.x.x of the package if you need to support Node 16 or below.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The package no longer provides a default export. This affects import statements in client code.
The `replace.sync` syntax is no longer available. Client code using this syntax will break.
The callback API has been removed for asynchronous replacements. Client code using callbacks will break.
Configuration files provided to the CLI using the `--configFile` flag can now only be JSON. Other formats will no longer work.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Convert any non-JSON configuration files to JSON format when using the CLI with the `--configFile` flag.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The way to specify custom `fs` implementation has changed. The previous approach will no longer work.
The behavior of the `cwd` parameter has changed. It now uses `path.join()` instead of basic string concatenation to ensure correct path concatenation.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: This change should generally improve path handling, but may break code that relied on the previous behavior. Ensure your paths are correctly formatted to work with `path.join()` instead of string concatenation.
